title: Curiosity
name: Leonardo da Vinci
qoute: Keep observing, questioning, experimenting, and learning across different fields.

title: Growth through Failure
name: Michael Jordan
qoute: Failure can be used as motivation to improve rather than as a reason to stop.

title: Self-knowledge
name: Socrates
qoute: A meaningful life requires questioning yourself, your beliefs, and the world around you.
